records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the first half of fiscal 2021, total operating expenses decreased by $3.2 million, to 10.2% of net sales compared to 10.5% for the first half of fiscal 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The increases in gross profit and gross profit margin were mainly attributable to lower commodity acquisition costs for tree nuts and the sales volume increase discussed above.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: The total value of inventories on hand at the end of the second quarter of fiscal 2021 decreased by $17.0 million, or 9.8%, in comparison to the total value of inventories on hand at the end of the second quarter of fiscal 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Total operating expenses for the second quarter of fiscal 2021 decreased by $0.5 million, or 2.0%, compared to the second quarter of fiscal 2020.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Due to the factors discussed above, income from operations was $27.8 million, or 11.9% of net sales, for the second quarter of fiscal 2021 compared to $24.5 million, or 9.9% of net sales, for the second quarter of fiscal 2020.
